content_sections.heading: APPSC AEE Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The APPSC AEE 2026 online application process will begin on 2 November 2026. Candidates can submit their applications until 22 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. The Commission has stated that the detailed notification will be available on or before the application opening date.

content_sections.heading: APPSC AEE Vacancy 2026 Department-wise Details
content_sections.text: The APPSC AEE Recruitment 2026 notification lists 503 provisional vacancies across eight post codes. The Water Resources Department has the largest combined vacancy allocation, followed by Panchayat Raj & Rural Development Engineering, Roads & Buildings and Rural Water Supply & Sanitation departments. Water Resources Vacancy Clarification: The brief notification provides a combined total of 224 vacancies for Civil and Mechanical AEE posts under Post Codes 07 and 08. The separate branch-wise totals are not given in this notification. Water Resources Department: 224 combined Civil and Mechanical posts. Panchayat Raj & Rural Development Engineering Department: 100 posts. Roads & Buildings Department: 75 Civil and 4 Electrical posts. Rural Water Supply & Sanitation Department: 73 posts. Public Health & Municipal Engineering Department: 21 posts. Tribal Welfare Engineering Department: 6 posts.

The brief notification lists 4 vacancies for this post.

content_sections.heading: APPSC AEE Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: APPSC has announced that the Assistant Executive Engineer recruitment examination will be conducted as a single-level examination in Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) mode. No separate screening test will be conducted, irrespective of the number of applications received. Single-level objective-type written examination. Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) mode. No separate screening test. Normalization may be applied if the examination is conducted in multiple sessions. The notification also includes a Computer Proficiency Test scheme in its annexures. Candidates should follow the detailed notification for its applicability in the final recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: APPSC AEE Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The APPSC AEE written examination consists of three objective-type papers at engineering degree standard. Each paper carries 150 questions and 150 marks, making a total of 450 questions and 450 marks. Negative Marking: One-third of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for each incorrect answer. The examination scheme directs candidates to appear for the papers relevant to their engineering degree and post code. The notification states that Paper III for Post Codes 02 and 06 will be conducted in different sessions.
